description: This header file 'tps.h' defines interfaces and data structures related to the Throttle Position Sensor (TPS) in a vehicle firmware project. It declares functions for reading TPS data, converting voltages, managing mock sensor values, and tracking rate of change, along with a data structure for rate of change calculations.

classes.name: tps_roc_s
classes.description: Structure for tracking the rate of change of the throttle position sensor (TPS), including previous and current time-value pairs and the rate of change in percentage per second.

methods.name: hasPedalPositionSensor
methods.description: Checks if a pedal position sensor is present.

methods.name: getPedalPosition
methods.description: Returns the current pedal position as a percentage.

methods.name: getTPS
methods.description: Returns the current throttle position as a percentage of Wide Open Throttle (WOT).

methods.name: hasTpsSensor
methods.description: Checks if the TPS sensor is present.

methods.name: convertVoltageTo10bitADC
methods.description: Converts a voltage value to a 10-bit ADC value.

methods.name: getTPS12bitAdc
methods.description: Returns the 12-bit ADC reading from the TPS sensor.

methods.name: getTPSVoltage
methods.description: Returns the voltage reading of the TPS sensor.

methods.name: getTpsValue
methods.description: Converts an ADC value into a percentage value for TPS.

methods.name: setBosch0280750009
methods.description: Configures specific hardware (likely a Bosch sensor or module).

methods.name: setMockTpsPosition
methods.description: Sets a mock TPS position for testing.

methods.name: setMockPedalPosition
methods.description: Sets a mock pedal position for testing.

methods.name: getTpsRateOfChange
methods.description: Returns the current rate of change of the TPS position.
